content.title: Coachella 2026: Every Surprise Guest Who Appeared This Year
content.text: Maddie Ziegler and Addison Rae pose backstage at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 11, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for CoachellaBy now, the list of artists who appear as special surprise guests at Coachella is almost as long and impressive as the actual lineup of booked performers.Some of the biggest surprises in past Coachellas included Madonna stepping on stage to perform — and make out with — Drake during his 2015 set, Justin Bieber teaming with Chance the Rapper in 2014, Solange bringing her big sister Beyoncé to shimmy alongside her in 2014, Calvin Harris featuring Rihanna for two songs in 2012, Arcade Fire singing “Heart of Glass” with Debbie Harry in 2014 or Lizzo joining Harry Styles for a joyful performance in 2022.Alongside Coachella headliners Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber and Karol G, artists like BIA and Anyma have already teased surprise appearances during their sets, the latter reportedly set to feature Muse, Joji and Lisa of BLACKPINK.If Coachella 2026 was already a musical weekend to remember, the special guests will make it even more so.Coachella 2026 - Weekend 11. Becky GAs Karol G was making history as the first Latina headliner at Coachella, she shared the moment with her fellow Latina Becky G to perform their massive hit “MAMIII.”Becky G performs with Karol G at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 12, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella2. Mariah AngeliqBut Becky wasn’t the only Latina that had a guest spot in Karol’s headlining set with Miami-born Mariah Angelilq also joining the headliner. The two had previously shared the stage in the past at the 2021 Latin American Music Awards.Mariah Angeliq (R) performs with Karol G at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 12, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella 3. Greg GonzalezThe Cigarettes After Sex singer and guitarist performed an unreleased song with Karol G during her Day 3 headlining set at Coachella.Karol G and Greg Gonzales performs at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 12, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella4. M.I.A.Major Lazer brought out M.I.A. during their Day 3 set to perform “Paper Planes,” reuniting Diplo with his former flame.M.I.A. performs with Diplo of Major Lazer at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 12, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella5. BINIWhile BINI performed their own set on Day 1, the Filipino girl group didn’t leave the desert and popped up during British singer-songwriter flowerovlove’s slot – down one girl because member Maloi was not feeling well.flowerovlove and BINI perform at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music And Arts Festival - Weekend 1 - Day 3 on April 12, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Christopher Polk/Billboard via Getty Images)Billboard via Getty Images6. Travis BarkerThe Blink-182 drummer accompanied Clipse’s Coachella set for songs “Chains & Whips” and “P.O.V.”Travis Barker performs at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music And Arts Festival - Weekend 1 - Day 3 on April 12, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Katie Flores/Billboard via Getty Images)Billboard via Getty Images7. Camila CabelloThe former Fifth Harmony member supported Young Thug’s set on Day 3 to perform their hit collab “Havana.” Camila Cabello performs with Young Thug at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 12, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella8. underscoresThe singer-songwriter-producer appeared during Oklou’s set to perform their collaboration “Harvest Sky” live.9. HorsegiirlThe half-human, half-horse artist popped up during WetLeg’s set on the Main stage during Day 3. horsegiirL performs with Rhian Teasdale of Wet Leg at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 12, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Matt Winkelmeyer/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for CoachellaHorsegiirl also appeared and performed during PinkPantheress’ set on Day 2.horsegiirL performs with PinkPantheress at the Mojave Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 11, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Arturo Holmes/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella10. TemsDay 2 headliner Justin Bieber brought out Tems during a performance of their “Essence” remix to close the second day of festivities.Justin Bieber and Tems perform at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 11, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella11. WizKidOne of the original singers on “Essence” alongside Tems, WizKid was also of course on hand at Bieber’s set to perform the trio’s Afrobeat-pop remix.12. The Kid LAROIThe Australian singer and Bieber friend came out to sing their megahit duet “Stay” during Justin’s headlining set.13. Jennifer LopezJ. Lo showed up during David Guetta’s Day 2 Coachella set to perform their new collaboration “Save Me Tonight” live.14. Billy CorganThe Smashing Pumpkins singer made Sombr giddy as the musicians duetted on “1979,” the ‘90s synth-rock hit from Corgan’s band.Sombr and Billy Corgan at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music And Arts Festival - Weekend 1 - Day 2 on April 11, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Christopher Polk/Billboard via Getty Images)Billboard via Getty Images15. Rauw AlejandroRauw Alejandro joins RØZ at the RedBull Mirage to play new version of "PONGO"Courtesy Photo via PressThe Puerto Rican superstar surprised Coachella’s RedBull Mirage with a surprise appearance during RØZ’s DJ set, vibing alongside the duo as they played a new version of “PONGO,” his latest track with Rvssian and Wizkid.16. Jhené AikoThe R&B songstress showed as a surprise guest during Swae Lee’s set on Day 2.Jhené Aiko and Swae Lee perform at the Sahara Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 10, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Arturo Holmes/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella17. NAVThe Toronto rapper also linked up with Swae Lee during his set at the Sahara Tent.Swae Lee and NAV perform at the Sahara Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 10, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Arturo Holmes/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for CoachellaNAV stuck around Indio all weekend and popped up to join Young Thug’s Day 3 set as one of the festival’s final performances.Nav performs with Young Thug at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 12, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella18. KehlaniGiveon invited the singer to perform her Grammy Award-winning hit “Folded” live during his Day 2 set.Kehlani performs with Giveon at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 11, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella19. ThundercatThe super-producer popped in to accompany Suicidal Tendencies on Day 3 of Coachella.Thundercat (R) performs with Mike Muir of Suicidal Tendencies at the Mojave Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 12, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Arturo Holmes/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for CoachellaA day before linking with Suicidal Tendencies, Thundercat also accompanied PinkPantheress in the middle of her set.Thundercat and PinkPantheress perform at the Mojave Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 11, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Arturo Holmes/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella20. Tyriq WithersThe Atlanta actor popped up during PinkPantheress’ set for a fun and flirty skit as her “Romeo” and accompanied the U.K. producer-singer as she performed her hit “Stateside.”Tyriq Withers performs with PinkPantheress at the Mojave Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 11, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Arturo Holmes/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella21. Maddie ZieglerThe famous dancer joined Addison Rae to perform a highly stylized rendition of “Aquamarine” at the pop star’s Coachella debut.Maddie Ziegler (R) performs with Addison Rae at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 11, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella22. 310babiiThe Inglewood, California rapper was one of many guests BIA brought out during her set on Day 2. 310babii and BIA previously collaborated on the track “back it up.” 310babii performs with BIA at the Gobi Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 11, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Amy Sussman/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella23. DDGThe streamer-rapper-boxer also joined BIA on stage to perform their collab “Fine Shyt” which was of course livestreamed to DDG’s followers.DDG performs with BIA at the Gobi Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 11, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Amy Sussman/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella24. OhGeesyBIA brought out another Cali rapper in OhGeesy during her set at the Gobi Tent. BIA previously appeared on a remix for his track “GEEKALEEK.”OhGeesy performs with Bia at the Gobi Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 11, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Amy Sussman/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella25. Natalie NunnIn one of the most surprising appearances of Coachella, Baddies star Natalie Nunn was also featured in BIA’s set and performed her 2025 single “Doin What I Want.”26. Destroy LonelyIn one of Coachella’s most unexpected crossover moments, Atlanta rapper Destroy Lonely previewed new music during dubstep producer Subtronics’ set on Day 2.27-29. HUNTR/X’s EJAE, Audrey Nuna and Rei Ami of KPop Demon HuntersKATSEYE began their cover of the KPop Demon Hunters hit single “Golden” before bringing out the real HUNTR/X singing voices of EJAE, Audrey Nuna and Rei Ami to join them in a major girl-group duet moment.Daniela Avanzini, Sophia Laforteza, Rei Ami, Ejae, Audrey Nuna, Lara Raj, Yoonchae Jeong and Megan Skiendiel of KATSEYE and HUNTR/X of KPop Demon Hunters perform at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music And Arts Festival - Weekend 1 - Day 1 on April 10, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Christopher Polk/Billboard via Getty Images)Billboard via Getty Images30. Will FerrelThe comedian appeared during Sabrina Carpenter’s headlining set on the first day of Coachella 2026.31. Susan SarandonThe Academy Award winner delivered a monologue as part of Sabrina Carpenter’s Day 1 headlining set.Susan Sarandon is seen onstage during Sabrina Carpenter at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 10, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella32. Corey FogelmanisSabrina Carpenter gave a major throwback to her early Disney Channel days by bringing out her former Girl Meets World cast mate Corey Fogelmanis during her set.33. Sam ElliottThe legendary deep-voiced actor also made an appearance in the visuals played during Sabrina Carpenter’s headlining Coachella set.34. Joe JonasTeddy Swims brought out the middle Jonas Brother to duet on the JoBros song “When You Look Me In The Eyes” during his Teddy Swims and Joe Jonas perform at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music And Arts Festival - Weekend 1 - Day 1 on April 10, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Christopher Polk/Billboard via Getty Images)Billboard via Getty Images35. Vanessa CarltonTeddy Swims delivered the 2002 smash “A Thousand Miles” with the singer-songwriter singing and accompanying him on stage as well.Vanessa Carlton and Teddy Swims perform at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 10, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella36. David Lee RothTeddy Swims also had the Van Halen star on hand to sing his band’s '80s hit “Jump.”David Lee Roth and Teddy Swims perform at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 10, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella37. Snoop DoggFrench DJ and record producer HUGEL had the rapper deliver some extra hype during his set at the Sahara Tent. Hugel and Snoop Dogg perform at the Sahara Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 10, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Matt Winkelmeyer/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella38. Lizzo No stranger to making surprise appearances at Coachella after joining Harry Styles for his headlining set at Coachella 2022, the superstar joined Kaytranada on stage during his set at 818 Outpost.The star popped up again on the kickoff day of Coachella 2026 to play her famous Sasha Flute during Day 1’s latest set for Sexyy Red. Elsewhere in the set, Lizzo grinded up next to a life-size Labubu dollLizzo performs with Sexyy Red at the Sahara Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 10, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Matt Winkelmeyer/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella39. Big SeanLevity brought out the rapper during the electronic-music trio’s set. Sean was also spotted hanging with HUGEL on the festivalgrounds.Levity and Big Sean perform at the Sahara Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival on April 10, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Matt Winkelmeyer/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for CoachellaThe Detroit rapper also popped up with HUGEL during the French DJ’s set.Big Sean performs with Hugel at the Sahara Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 10, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Matt Winkelmeyer/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for Coachella40. Porter RobinsonThe electronic producer joined Ninajirachi to debut a new collaboration live for festivalgoers.41. Jacob LuskCalling the American Idol alum “a man who I believe is possibly the single greatest singer on the planet,” Moby brought out Jacob Lusk to deliver vocals for the songs “When It’s Cold I’d Like to Die” and “Natural Blues.” Jacob Lusk performs with Moby at the Mojave Tent during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 10, 2026 in Indio, California. (Photo by Amy Sussman/Getty Images for Coachella)Getty Images for CoachellaStay tuned for more surprise guests and more updates from Coachella 2026 here.
